## Public repository checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the full diff for secrets, hostnames, internal identifiers, and non-public information.
- [ ] New documentation and configuration examples contain only public, generic content.
- [ ] Performance figures, if any, come from a fully described reproducible environment or are labelled as hypotheses.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Format or protocol changes bump the relevant version field and add a compatibility test.
